components.label: Page
components.description: The root of every rendered page. It scrolls down; nothing inside it scrolls down by itself.

props.name: title
props.label: Title
props.help: The page's heading.

props.name: density
props.label: Density
props.help: How tightly the page is packed.

renders.desktop: A scrolling column beside the sidebar, the title as a heading, content at most 1600 points wide.
renders.phone: A scrolling column under a large title that collapses into the navigation bar; sections 24 points apart, rows bleed to the screen's edges.
renders.tablet: As a phone, with 16-point side margins (the m spacing, as on every form factor but the television).
renders.tv: A full-screen column inside the safe area (60 points top and bottom, 90 at the sides), sections 40 points apart. The title isn't drawn: the top menu says where you are.

components.a11y: Role: main. Label: the title.

components.label: Spotlight
components.description: A large rotating spotlight of a few titles: backdrop, title or logo, a line of facts, a synopsis and buttons.

props.name: title
props.label: Title
props.help: Named to assistive technology; not drawn.

props.name: style
props.label: Style
props.help: A full billboard, or a shorter banner.

props.name: autoAdvanceSec
props.label: Seconds per title
props.help: How long each title stays before the next one. 0 never moves by itself.

props.name: showSynopsis
props.label: Show the synopsis
props.help: Two or three lines about the title.

props.name: showLogo
props.label: Use the title's logo
props.help: The title's logo art in place of its name, when it has one.

props.name: actions
props.label: Buttons
props.help: The buttons on each title, in order.

props.name: maxItems
props.label: Most titles
props.help: How many titles it rotates through.

props.name: peek
props.label: Show the next title's edge
props.help: A sliver of the next title (layout.peek of the slide's width) shows at the trailing edge of the spotlight on a phone or tablet, so it is clear there is more to swipe to. A television's buttons row and a desktop's arrows say it already.

renders.desktop: A 21/9 backdrop at most 620 points tall, text block bottom-left, arrows at the edges on hover, page dots bottom-right.
renders.phone: A 16/9 backdrop the width of the screen (2/3 with style billboard), title and facts over a bottom scrim, buttons below; swipe sideways to change title, page dots under it. With peek, the slide is narrowed by layout.peek of its width so the next one's edge shows.
renders.tablet: A 21/9 backdrop with the text block at the bottom-left third.
renders.tv: The top 620 points of the screen: backdrop full width behind a left-to-right scrim, the logo or title at the heading size bottom-left, facts, at most three lines of synopsis, then the buttons in a row. Left and right on the buttons' row past its ends change title; it never advances while one of its buttons has focus.

states.loading: A grey block of the hero's size.

components.a11y: Role: region, labelled by the title prop or "Featured". Each slide is a group labelled "<title>, <facts joined by comma>", announced politely when it changes. With reduced motion it does not advance by itself and cross-fades are cuts.

components.label: Row
components.description: A titled row of cards that scrolls sideways. The workhorse of a home page.

props.name: title
props.label: Title
props.help: The heading above the items. Placeholders such as {library} and {each} are filled in.

props.name: subtitle
props.label: Subtitle
props.help: A smaller line under the title.

props.name: headingStyle
props.label: Heading style
props.help: How the title is drawn: plain, a coloured band across the row, or underlined. Left plain, the experience chooses.

props.name: cardStyle
props.label: Card style
props.help: How each item is drawn. Auto uses the style that suits the source.

props.name: cardSize
props.label: Card size
props.help: Small, medium or large cards. A profile may choose its own.

props.name: showTitles
props.label: Show titles under cards
props.help: Off draws the pictures alone; the titles are still read out.

props.name: seeAll
props.label: See all
props.help: A link to everything the row is drawn from, when the source has such a place.

props.name: numbered
props.label: Number the cards
props.help: Large rank numbers beside the cards, for a top ten.

props.name: maxItems
props.label: Most cards at first
props.help: How many cards are sent before the row asks for more. 0 uses the device's own limit.

props.name: peek
props.label: Show the next card's edge
props.help: layout.peek of the next card's width stays visible at the row's trailing edge, so it is clear the row scrolls on. Off cuts the row at a whole card.

props.name: seeAllCard
props.label: See all as a card
props.help: See all as the last card of the row, in the shape of the row's cards, in place of the link beside the heading. Automatic: on a television and in the experiences that ask for it (Stage, Big picture).

props.name: empty
props.label: When there is nothing to show
props.help: Leave the section out, or keep it with a message.

props.name: emptyText
props.label: Message when empty
props.help: Shown in place of the items when there are none.

renders.desktop: A heading with a "See all" link at its end, a row that scrolls by wheel, drag or the arrow buttons that appear at its ends on hover; arrow keys move focus card to card.
renders.phone: A heading with a chevron when there is a See all, then a row that scrolls by touch and bleeds off both edges; cards 12 points apart.
renders.tv: A heading at the title size, then one row of cards that scrolls sideways under focus (cards layout.spacing.m apart, the next card peeking in by layout.peek of its width), the focused card kept a safe-area's width from the left edge and raised with the system's focus effect. The row is one focus section and remembers its last card. With props.seeAllCard, "See all" is a final card of the row's shape (its label in the title style, an arrow icon, the same corner), reached by moving past the last title; otherwise it is a link beside the heading.

states.deferred: Drawn as loading until the client has asked props.more.url, which it does when the section is within one screen of being seen.
states.empty: Left out of the page; with empty "message", the heading and emptyText in the caption style where the items would be.
states.error: The heading and one line, "Couldn't load this", with a Retry button that asks props.more.url again.
states.loading: Its heading, and as many grey placeholder cards of the card's size as fit, pulsing unless the device asks for reduced motion.

components.a11y: Role: list, labelled by the title. Each card is a list item. When numbered, a card's label starts with "Number <n>".

components.label: Grid

renders.phone: As many columns of the card's width as fit, at least 2 (3 for posters at size s or m), 12 points apart.
renders.tablet: As many columns as fit, 16 points apart.

components.a11y: Role: grid (list on touch devices), labelled by the title or the page's title.

components.label: Card
components.description: One item in a Shelf, Grid, Hero or SeasonList. Made by the server from the source's items; see the card styles for what each style shows.

props.name: style
props.label: Style
props.help: The card style.

props.name: shape
props.label: Shape
props.help: poster, landscape, square, circle or chip: what a renderer that doesn't know the style draws.

props.name: title
props.label: Title
props.help: Always sent, and always in the label, even where the style doesn't draw it.

props.name: synopsis
props.label: Synopsis
props.help: Episode cards and hero slides.

props.name: remaining
props.label: Time left
props.help: Progress cards: "42 min left".

props.name: itemId
props.label: Item
props.help: The item's ID.

props.name: kind
props.label: Kind
props.help: The item's kind.

props.name: playId
props.label: Plays
props.help: What a play affordance on the card starts, when the item can be played.

props.name: image
props.label: Picture
props.help: {url, width, height, aspect, kind}: the address with the width to ask for.

props.name: progress
props.label: Progress
props.help: 0 to 1.

props.name: badges
props.label: Badges
props.help: At most three short labels.

props.name: rank

props.help: In a numbered row.

props.help: {title, start, end}

props.name: next
props.label: On next
props.help: {title, start, end}

props.name: icon

props.help: For tiles and chips without a picture.

props.name: facts
props.label: Facts
props.help: Hero slides: [{id, value}].

props.name: actions
props.label: Buttons
props.help: Hero slides: [{id, label, icon, primary, action}].

props.name: logo
props.label: Logo
props.help: Hero slides: the title's logo art.

renders.desktop: Picture with a hover scrim and play button when it can be played, title and subtitle under it; a context menu on right click.
renders.phone: Picture, then title and subtitle under it in the title and caption sizes. A long press opens the app's own item menu.
renders.tv: The picture at the row's card size with the system focus effect (lift, parallax on tvOS; scale 1.08 and a 3-point ring in token accent elsewhere); the title appears under the focused card only, unless showTitles.

states.error: The picture's place filled with token bg3 and the item kind's icon.
states.loading: A grey rounded rectangle of the card's shape.

components.a11y: Role: button (link on the web). Label: the props its style shows, in the style's order, joined by ", ": progress as "<n> percent watched", watched as "Watched", unwatched as "<n> unwatched", badges as written, a channel as "Channel <number>, <title>, now <now.title>, next <next.title>".

components.label: Tabs
components.description: A strip of tabs, each with its own sections. Only the selected tab's content is sent; choosing another asks for the page again with tab=<id>.

props.name: style
props.label: Style
props.help: Tabs for sections of a page, segments for views of the same thing.

props.name: default
props.label: Opens on
props.help: The tab shown first. A profile may choose its own.

renders.desktop: Text tabs with an underline in token accent, left-aligned; arrow keys move between them, Enter selects.
renders.phone: A segmented control (segments) or a scrolling row of text tabs with an underline (tabs); swiping the content sideways changes tab.
renders.tv: A row of pills centred above the content; left and right move between them and the content changes as focus moves; down enters the content.

components.a11y: Role: tablist; each Tab is a tab with selected state; the content is its tabpanel.

components.label: Tab
components.description: One tab of a Tabs section: a label and the sections shown when it is chosen.

props.name: label
props.label: Label
props.help: The tab's name.

props.name: icon
props.label: Icon
props.help: One of the built-in icons.

components.a11y: Role: tab. Label: the label.

components.label: Carousel

renders.phone: The same, swiped: the card in the middle is large, the next and previous peek in by layout.peek.
renders.tv: A row of cards centred on the focused one, which is drawn at 1.25 times the others with the focus ring; left and right move the row so the focused card stays in the middle; its title, facts and a Play button are under it. The row is one focus section.

components.a11y: Role: list, labelled by the title. The focused card is announced with its position, "<title>, <n> of <total>".

components.label: Cross bar
components.description: A horizontal bar of categories with a vertical list under the chosen one, as a game console has. Only the selected category's content is sent; choosing another asks for the page again with tab=<id>.

props.name: default
props.label: Opens on
props.help: The category shown first. A profile may choose its own.

renders.desktop: The same as the television's, with the pointer choosing a category.
renders.phone: A scrolling row of icons and names under the title; the list under it is the page.
renders.tv: Icons with names along a bar a third of the way down the screen; left and right move the bar, the chosen category's list opens below it in the title size, up and down move through it, OK opens an entry.

components.a11y: Role: tablist; each Tab is a tab with selected state; the list under it is its tabpanel.

components.label: Widgets
components.description: A grid of widgets, each in its own cell: continue watching, what is on TV now, statistics, the server's status, a clock. Every cell can be moved and resized by the administrator and by the profile.

props.name: columns
props.label: Columns
props.help: How many columns the grid has on a wide screen; narrower windows use fewer.

renders.desktop: The columns the grid says, widgets keeping their cells.
renders.phone: Two columns at most; a widget wider than that takes the full width.
renders.tv: layout.dock aside, the safe area's width divided into the columns, cells layout.spacing.m apart; focus moves cell to cell by direction, and a cell with items is a row inside it.

components.a11y: Role: group, labelled by the page's title. Each widget is a region labelled by its title.

components.label: Widget
components.description: One cell of a widget grid. Its kind says what it shows; kinds that list titles take their items from their kind's source, or from the section's own.

props.name: kind
props.label: Kind
props.help: What the widget shows.

props.name: title
props.label: Title
props.help: The widget's heading; left empty it is the kind's own.

props.name: x
props.label: Column
props.help: The cell's column, from 0.

props.name: y
props.label: Row
props.help: The cell's row, from 0.

props.name: w
props.label: Width
props.help: Columns the cell spans.

props.name: h
props.label: Height
props.help: Rows the cell spans.

renders.all: A panel at elevation 1 with its title in the heading size. continue, liveNow and recordings hold a row of cards (or a list when the cell is narrow); stats holds the statistics source as a figure or a short list; serverStatus holds a line per figure (libraries, playing now, free space); clock draws the time and date in the device's own format and needs no data.

components.a11y: Role: region, labelled by the title.

components.label: Numbered rows
components.description: Listing rows with a number column: a channel's number, or the place in the list. A guide's channel list, a top ten.

props.name: title
props.label: Title
props.help: The heading above the items. Placeholders such as {library} and {each} are filled in.

props.name: headingStyle
props.label: Heading style
props.help: How the title is drawn: plain, a coloured band across the row, or underlined. Left plain, the experience chooses.

props.label: Numbers
props.help: Channel numbers where the items are channels, else their place in the list.

props.name: maxItems
props.label: Most rows at first
props.help: How many rows are sent before the list asks for more. 0 uses the device's own limit.

props.name: empty
props.label: When there is nothing to show
props.help: Leave the section out, or keep it with a message.

props.name: emptyText
props.label: Message when empty
props.help: Shown in place of the items when there are none.

renders.desktop: A table: number, title, subtitle; double-click opens.
renders.phone: Full-width rows 56 points tall with the number at the start.
renders.tv: A row per item at layout.text.title: the number in a fixed column at the start (as wide as the longest), the logo or picture, then the title and subtitle; the focused row is filled.

states.deferred: Drawn as loading until the client has asked props.more.url, which it does when the section is within one screen of being seen.
states.empty: Left out of the page; with empty "message", the heading and emptyText in the caption style where the items would be.

components.a11y: Role: list, labelled by the title. Each row: "<number>, <title>, <subtitle>".

components.label: Filter and sort
components.description: The controls that filter and sort a Grid on the same page. The server fills in each filter's choices from what the library holds; a change asks for the page again with the choice as a query parameter. With showCount, the server sends count (a number) and countText, the words to show ("1 title", "12 titles").

props.name: target
props.label: Filters
props.help: The Grid this bar filters. Its source must be filterable.

props.name: fields
props.label: Filters
props.help: Which filters are offered, in order. One with no choices in this library is left out.

props.name: sorts
props.label: Sort by
props.help: The orders offered; the first is the default.

props.name: showCount
props.label: Show how many
props.help: The number of titles found.

renders.desktop: A row of drop-downs with the count at the far end and a Clear button when anything is chosen.
renders.phone: A row of chips that scrolls sideways; a chip opens a bottom sheet of choices. The count sits above it in the caption style.
renders.tv: One row of pills: Sort first, then each filter showing its current choice; OK on a pill opens a full-height list from the right edge to choose from.

components.a11y: Role: toolbar, labelled "Filter and sort". Each field is a pop-up button labelled "<label>: <current choice or Any>".

components.label: Dock
components.description: The persistent controls of one screen, in one row that never moves: for a grid, its sort, filters, view and jump to a letter. It is where the screen's options key leads, and it carries the key legend. Put it last on the page.

props.name: title
props.label: Name
props.help: Named to assistive technology: "Options" when left empty.

props.name: target
props.label: Controls
props.help: The Grid its generated controls act on, which a FilterBar on the page filters. Without one only its own Buttons are drawn.

props.name: controls
props.label: Controls
props.help: Generated buttons, in order: sort and filters (when a filter bar drives the target), the view (grid or list) and jump to a letter. One that has nothing to offer is left out.

props.name: legend
props.label: Key legend
props.help: A KeyLegend at the end, for the keys of the device in use.

renders.desktop: The same bar across the bottom of the content, layout.dock.height points tall, below the page's scroll; the options key (a period) or Shift+F10 moves focus to it.
renders.phone: No bar: layout.dock.placement is sheet. The controls are one "Options" button at the end of the page's header that opens them as a bottom sheet, in the same order; the legend is left out.
renders.tablet: The same bar, layout.dock.height points tall, above the bottom bar.
renders.tv: A bar layout.dock.height points tall across the bottom of the screen, inside the safe area, outside the page's scroll: one row of buttons at the title size with the key legend at the trailing end. It never moves and never wraps. It takes focus with Down from the last row of the page, with the options key from anywhere, or with Start; Up returns to the same place. Left and right wrap inside it, the only place that does.

components.a11y: Role: toolbar, labelled by its name. Each control is a button labelled as written ("Sort: Title"). The legend is hidden from assistive technology: its keys are in every control's hint.

components.label: Key legend
components.description: A line of key hints ("OK Select", "Menu Options") in glyphs matched to the input in use: a keyboard's key caps, a game pad's buttons, a remote's. Hidden when only touch or a mouse is in use. Normally the last thing in a Dock.

props.name: actions
props.label: Hints
props.help: Which actions are shown, in order. The glyphs come from the input table in themes/tokens.json for the device in use.

renders.desktop: The same row at the caption size, shown only while the last input was a key or a game pad; a mouse or touch hides it, the first key brings it back. Glyphs are key caps (the key, or its name).
renders.phone: Not drawn unless a keyboard or pad is in use; touch alone never shows it.
renders.tablet: As the desktop's, shown only with a keyboard or pad.
renders.tv: One row of hints at tv.dock.hintSize (25 units), the glyph then its label in the caption style, in token fg2, at the trailing end of the Dock. Always drawn: a remote is always in use.

components.a11y: Role: none (hidden). The keys are announced as each control's hint instead.

components.label: Title header
components.description: The top of a title's page: its art, name, facts, score, synopsis and the buttons that play it and act on it. It shows the title the page was opened for. A button that is a toggle (Watch later) has pressed true or false: draw it as on or off and say so to a screen reader; its label and command already match the state.

props.name: layout
props.label: Layout
props.help: Backdrop behind the text, poster beside it, or a compact strip.

props.name: actions
props.label: Buttons
props.help: The buttons offered, in order. One the title or the profile can't use is left out.

props.name: facts
props.label: Facts
props.help: The line of facts under the title, in order.

renders.desktop: Backdrop behind; poster at the left (layout poster or backdrop), text block beside it, buttons in a row: primary filled, the rest outlined.
renders.phone: Backdrop 16/9 at the top, title and facts under it, a full-width primary button, the other actions as a row of icon buttons with captions, then the synopsis, cut to four lines with More.
renders.tablet: As a phone with the poster beside the text block.
renders.tv: Backdrop across the whole screen under a scrim; the logo or title at the page title size at the left, the facts on one line, at most four lines of synopsis, the buttons in a row with Play first and focused. Sections below scroll up over the backdrop.

states.error: A Notice: "This title isn't available" with a button back to Home.
states.loading: A grey backdrop and three grey text lines.

components.a11y: Role: region labelled by the title. The title is a level-1 heading. Each button's label is its label, the primary button's "Resume from <time>" when it resumes.

components.label: Seasons and episodes

props.name: style
props.label: Episodes as
props.help: Cards with a still and synopsis, or a compact list.

renders.desktop: Season tabs, then a vertical list (style list) or a wrapping grid of episode cards (style cards).
renders.phone: A season menu button, then the episodes as a vertical list: still at the left with a progress bar, title, runtime and two lines of synopsis.
renders.tv: A row of season pills, then the episodes as a row of episode cards (still, "<n>. <title>", runtime, two lines of synopsis) that scrolls sideways; focus starts on the next episode to watch.

components.a11y: Role: region labelled "Episodes". The season picker is a pop-up button "Season <n>"; each episode's label is "Episode <n>, <title>, <runtime>, <n> percent watched".

components.label: Track list

props.help: For compilations.

renders.phone: Full-width rows 56 points tall: number, title over artist, length; swipe actions are the app's own.
renders.tv: A list down the right two thirds of the screen, one row per track: number, title, length; the playing track in token accent.

states.error: The heading and one line, "Couldn't load this", with a Retry button that asks props.more.url again.

pageKinds.label: Home
pageKinds.description: The first page of the app.

pageKinds.label: Libraries
pageKinds.description: Every library the profile can open.

pageKinds.label: A title
pageKinds.description: The page of one film, show, episode, album, artist, book, game or collection, or of a person in the cast or crew.

pageKinds.label: Books
pageKinds.description: Books, comics and audiobooks together: the book libraries and the audiobook libraries.

pageKinds.label: A page of your own
pageKinds.description: Any other page: a family film night, a page for one collection.

commands.label: Watch later
commands.description: Adds the title to the profile's Watch later list.

commands.label: Remove from Watch later
commands.description: Takes the title off the profile's Watch later list.

commands.label: Mark watched
commands.description: Marks the title watched; for a show, every episode.

commands.label: Mark unwatched
commands.description: Forgets the profile's progress in the title; for a show, in every episode.

commands.label: Choose a tab
commands.description: Asks for the page again with tab=<params.tab>, or shows the tab's content when the client already has it.

commands.label: Open a control
commands.description: Client-handled, from a Dock: params.control is sort, filter, view or jump and params.target the Grid. sort and filter open the page's FilterBar choices for the target; view switches it between its grid and a list and remembers it for the profile on the device; jump opens a letter picker (A to Z and #) and brings the grid to the first title starting with the letter by asking its more.url until one has arrived, at most 20 pages.

commands.label: Open a room
commands.description: WittyPlay Online: opens the game being played (item: its session) to the friends who may see it, so they join with no code. Answers the host's code.

commands.label: Join a room
commands.description: WittyPlay Online: takes a seat in an open room (item: its session) or, with params.code, the room that code belongs to (no item).

commands.label: Invite someone
commands.description: WittyPlay Online: a join code for the game being played (item: its session), good for a short while, which a phone's QR join link carries. Answers {code, expiresAt}.

commands.label: Save state
commands.description: WittyPlay: saves the game being played (item: its session) into params.slot.

commands.label: Load state
commands.description: WittyPlay: loads params.slot into the game being played (item: its session).

commands.label: Delete a save state
commands.description: WittyPlay: deletes the profile's save in params.slot of the game (item: the game's ID, not a session).

commands.label: Move a player
commands.description: WittyPlay Online: the host puts the profile params.user in seat params.seat of the game being played (item: its session); a held seat is swapped.

commands.label: Rewind
commands.description: Client-handled, in the game player: opens the player's rewind panel. No request.

commands.label: Remap controls
commands.description: Client-handled, in the game player: opens the player's own controller-mapping panel. No request.

nativeScreens.label: Settings
nativeScreens.description: The app's own Settings. Always in the navigation; never an SDUI page.

nativeScreens.label: TV guide
nativeScreens.description: The guide's grid of channels and times.

nativeScreens.label: Who's watching
nativeScreens.description: The profile's own page and the profile switcher.

nativeScreens.label: Downloads
nativeScreens.description: What is kept on this device.

nativeScreens.label: Collections
nativeScreens.description: The app's own collections manager, where it has one; else the collections page.

nativeScreens.label: Download
nativeScreens.description: Keep a copy of a title on this device (action params: item).

nativeScreens.label: Share
nativeScreens.description: The share sheet for a title (action params: item).

nativeScreens.label: Play on…
nativeScreens.description: The device picker for a title (action params: item).

nativeScreens.label: Watch party
nativeScreens.description: Start a watch party for a title (action params: item).

experiences.name: Lumen
experiences.description: Top pills, a billboard spotlight and rows that peek at the next card. The default.

experiences.name: Rail
experiences.description: An icon rail that opens into a full menu and a drawer for each library, with title-on-art cards.

experiences.name: Stage
experiences.description: A see-through menu over a full-bleed spotlight, then rows of wide cards that overlap the art.

experiences.name: Aero
experiences.description: Glossy glass bars, bevelled pills, sky and leaf gradients and rounded corners. Gloss and gradients, no heavy blur.

experiences.name: Classic
experiences.description: The menu down the side, a tab bar on a phone and the top menu on a television. Today's design, polished.

experiences.name: Classic Cable
experiences.description: Flat blue rows, yellow highlights and coloured band headings, like a cable guide.

experiences.name: Classic Satellite
experiences.description: Silver bevelled bars, orange highlights and logo tiles for channels.

experiences.name: Compact
experiences.description: A rail and a line per title: the most on the screen at once, for power users and long libraries.

experiences.name: Paper
experiences.description: Top tabs, big serif type and generous space, on warm paper.

experiences.name: Marquee
experiences.description: One big title at a time in a centred carousel of posters.

experiences.name: Crossbar
experiences.description: A horizontal bar of categories with a vertical list under the chosen one. Games and music first.

experiences.name: Big picture
experiences.description: Huge tiles, few choices and the strongest focus, with larger type and targets.

experiences.name: Dashboard
experiences.description: A tile grid of widgets: continue watching, on TV now, statistics, server status, a clock. Every tile movable.

experiences.name: Retro
experiences.description: Teletext and CRT: block type, eight colours and colour-coded keys. Scanlines are off until turned on.
